the-analytical-engine-film.title: The Analytical Engine
the-analytical-engine-film.draft: It is a film about a machine that never got built, and it is smart enough to know that the interesting part is the arguing rather than the brass. The middle act sags because it wants a villain and there wasn't one; the last twenty minutes recover it completely.

second-order.title: Second Order
second-order.draft: The only show I have seen that treats a research group as a workplace with politics rather than as a montage. Nobody has a breakthrough in the shower. People are wrong for six episodes and then slightly less wrong, which is what it is actually like.

the-quiet-instrument.title: The Quiet Instrument
the-quiet-instrument.draft: A history of measurement that keeps its nerve and refuses to make every chapter about a genius. The chapter on failed standards is worth the whole book: it is the only place I have read a serious account of what happens when a unit is agreed on and then quietly ignored.

hollow-orbit.title: Hollow Orbit
hollow-orbit.draft: Three enormous songs and four that exist to make the record long enough to be an album. I keep going back for the second track and skipping most of what surrounds it, which is a verdict on the sequencing rather than on the band.

riverstone.title: Riverstone
riverstone.draft: Beautifully written and about nothing. I finished it out of stubbornness and could not tell you what happened in the second half.
